name: League of Legends
layout_summary: Client UI: top-left has blue 'PLAY' button; top bar has HOME, TFT, CLASH, and right-side icons for Profile, Collection (backpack), Loot (Hextech chest), Store (coins); right sidebar is Friends & Social list; bottom-center has 'CONFIRM' / 'FIND MATCH' button in lobbies. In-Game UI: champion abilities at bottom-center, minimap at bottom-right, shop via 'P'.
avoid_traps: In mode selection, clicking a mode card (Summoner's Rift / ARAM / TFT) does NOT enter the lobby until you also click 'CONFIRM' at the bottom-center.
In-game uses a hardware cursor/DirectX surface where UIA is blind — always prefer keyboard hotkeys (P for shop, B for recall, Tab for scoreboard, Y for camera lock).

play_lobby.primary: smart_click('PLAY button at top-left of client')
play_lobby.visual_fallback: smart_click('blue PLAY emblem at top-left corner')
play_lobby.verify: Game mode selection screen (PVP / Co-op vs AI / Training) opens

select_mode.primary: smart_click('game mode card (Summoner\'s Rift / ARAM / TFT)') -> smart_click('CONFIRM button at bottom-center')
select_mode.verify: Enters party lobby with FIND MATCH button at bottom-center

find_match.visual_fallback: smart_click('blue FIND MATCH button at bottom')

accept_match.visual_fallback: smart_click('ACCEPT button in match found circle')
accept_match.verify: Match is accepted and transitions to Champion Select

open_collection.primary: smart_click('backpack Collection icon in top bar')
open_collection.visual_fallback: smart_click('Collection icon left of Loot chest in top bar')
open_collection.verify: Champions / Skins / Runes / Spells collection view opens

open_loot.primary: smart_click('chest Loot icon in top bar')
open_loot.visual_fallback: smart_click('Hextech crafting chest icon in top navigation bar')
open_loot.verify: Loot and Hextech Crafting inventory opens

open_store.primary: smart_click('coins Store icon in top bar')
open_store.visual_fallback: smart_click('stack of gold coins icon in top navigation bar')

in_game_shop.verify: In-game item shop opens or closes

in_game_chat.verify: In-game chat input opens, types message, and sends

in_game_recall.verify: Champion begins 8-second recall channel back to base

in_game_center_camera.verify: Camera centers on the player's champion

in_game_lock_camera.visual_fallback: smart_click('camera lock icon next to minimap')
in_game_lock_camera.verify: Camera toggles between locked and unlocked mode
